[ 06 ] ONE RADAR. TWO ECONOMIES.

One Standard of Proof.

Intelligence before the wallet acts.

Solana leads with service spending intelligence. Robinhood Chain leads with read-only market inspection. Both use the same trust principles and receipt authority.

Pay.sh is a spend rail. Judgment assesses the action under policy. Separately authorized infrastructure handles execution.
